articles.title: Entegris Enters Silicon Carbide and Diamond-Enabled Thermal Management Materials Market for AI Advanced Packaging

articles.summary: Entegris, Inc. today announced an expansion of its strategic partnership with Kioxia Corporation to accelerate materials innovation for future generations of BiCS FLASH™ 3D flash memory and next-generation computing. As artificial intelligence expands across data centers, enterprise systems and edge computing, memory is becoming increasingly important to system performance and power efficiency. Future memory architectures will require advances in device design, materials and process technology to meet growing performance and capacity requirements. The expanded collaboration is designed to align future device requirements more closely with materials innovation. It combines Entegris’ capabilities in materials science, computational modeling, simulation and semiconductor process solutions with Kioxia’s expertise in memory technology and process integration. articles.title: Entegris Expands Strategic Partnership with Kioxia to Accelerate Materials Innovation for Next-Generation Memory in the AI Era
